JPMorgan Sees No Clear Endgame for Oil Markets
An attack on Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline has disrupted a crucial route around the Strait of Hormuz, threatening crude deliveries to Europe and adding pressure to already tight diesel markets. On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg Economics Statecraft Lead Chris Kennedy discusses how JPMorgan says it no longer has a baseline view for oil markets as the Iran conflict, attacks on Russian energy infrastructure, and uncertainty over Chinese demand make the outlook increasingly difficult to model. (Source: Bloomberg)

Kevin Warsh may be the adult in the room. But can he calm the US economy?
Fed chair presided over unanimous decision to raise interest rates despite intense campaign from White House  In the end, Kevin Warsh’s Federal Reserve acquitted itself well. For all the uncertainty he had sparked at the previous meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee, when he refused to provide any indication of what he was prepared to do to tame stubborn inflation, the chair on Wednesday presided over a unanimous decision to  raise interest rates  for the first time in three years.  “Today’s action starts to show that we’re serious about this,” he said at the press conference after the meeting, with “this” meaning inflation in excess of the Fed’s 2% target for over five years. Welcom

Far less well-remembered are the fukuryu – suicide frogmen trained in the closing months of World War II to walk into the sea with mines on bamboo poles, then wait beneath the waves for an Allied invasion fleet.
Kanade Hamamoto was one of many Japanese people who had never heard of them, despite...

美国总统特朗普当地时间9月19日在社交媒体发文称，他将组建一支“人工智能部队”。特朗普说，为组建“人工智能部队”，他将在不久后任命一名人工智能事务“总管”。他称，人工智能代表着下一场工业革命或互联网浪潮，其规模和影响力将更大，甚至可能占到美国国内生产总值的25%。特朗普还在帖文中抨击激进的民主党人“企图摧毁人工智能”，称“我们绝不会以任何方式阻碍或扼杀这个令人瞩目的产业发展。相反，我们要珍视它、扶持它，并守护它的成长”。特朗普称，其政府不会以任何方式阻碍或压制人工智能产业发展，而将支持并推动这一产业成长。他同时表示，美国将借现有的刑事与民事司法体系，严惩人工智能相关不法行为。（央视新闻）

China is now Rwanda’s biggest export market – now comes the hard part
In the first quarter of 2026, China became the leading destination for Rwandan exports, accounting for 26% of the total, compared with less than 5% just one year earlier. A spectacular shift, driven by the removal of Chinese tariffs on almost all Rwandan products. But on the ground, access to this market of 1.4 billion consumers depends less on tariffs than on meeting sanitary standards. Report by Aurore Bayoud.

US Greenland Deal Shifts Focus to Investment
A new security agreement between the US, Denmark and Greenland would expand the American military role while preserving Greenlandic sovereignty, shifting attention toward potential US investment in mining, infrastructure and tourism. Former US diplomat Lewis Lukens tells David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend that Greenland welcomes investment but faces formidable obstacles including limited transportation infrastructure, a small workforce and the high cost of developing projects in the Arctic. (Source: Bloomberg)

This comes after European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed making Canada the EU’s first associate member. Analysis by Guillaume Lavoie, associate member of the Raoul-Dandurand chair in strategic and diplomatic studies.

JPMorgan Sees No Clear Endgame for Oil Markets
An attack on Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline has disrupted a crucial route around the Strait of Hormuz, threatening crude deliveries to Europe and adding pressure to already tight diesel markets. On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg Economics Statecraft Lead Chris Kennedy discusses how JPMorgan says it no longer has a baseline view for oil markets as the Iran conflict, attacks on Russian energy infrastructure, and uncertainty over Chinese demand make the outlook increasingly difficult to model. (Source: Bloomberg)
main_items.title: JPMorgan Sees No Clear Endgame for Oil Markets

main_items.text:
土耳其外长：不接受沙特被卷入美伊冲突
当地时间9月19日，土耳其外交部长费丹接受采访。在被问及沙特阿拉伯与也门胡塞武装之间的冲突时，费丹表示，土方不接受沙特被卷入当前美国与伊朗之间的冲突，沙特自身也无意卷入冲突。他表示，近期针对沙特领土完整、主权和基础设施的袭击十分严重。费丹称，旨在结束战斗的有关方案已转达各方。费丹还表示，作为土耳其、沙特和巴基斯坦三国防务机制成员，土耳其正密切关注沙特局势。沙特可能存在一些军事需求，特别是在技术领域，土方将在三边防务机制框架内对此进行评估，并愿为满足相关需求提供帮助。（央视新闻）

Kevin Warsh may be the adult in the room. But can he calm the US economy?
Fed chair presided over unanimous decision to raise interest rates despite intense campaign from White House  In the end, Kevin Warsh’s Federal Reserve acquitted itself well. For all the uncertainty he had sparked at the previous meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee, when he refused to provide any indication of what he was prepared to do to tame stubborn inflation, the chair on Wednesday presided over a unanimous decision to  raise interest rates  for the first time in three years.  “Today’s action starts to show that we’re serious about this,” he said at the press conference after the meeting, with “this” meaning inflation in excess of the Fed’s 2% target for over five years. Welcom

A new security agreement between the US, Denmark and Greenland would expand the American military role while preserving Greenlandic sovereignty, shifting attention toward potential US investment in mining, infrastructure and tourism. Former US diplomat Lewis Lukens tells David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend that Greenland welcomes investment but faces formidable obstacles including limited transportation infrastructure, a small workforce and the high cost of developing projects in the Arctic.
